string.text: Documents from the stash
Documents Beard asked you to recover on Zaton. Owl may also be interested.
Beard's errand: find the documents
Recover the documents from the marked stash on Zaton.
Return the documents to Beard
Take the documents to Beard at the Skadovsk. He offered 2000 rubles and equipment.
Find another buyer
Return to Beard or ask Pilot at the Skadovsk about another buyer.
Sell the documents to Owl
Pilot suggested Owl. Owl offers 5000 rubles, but Beard will be disappointed.
Gloomy
Grey
Fang
A Zaton stalker travelling with Gloomy.
Beard, do you have a job involving documents?
Recover some documents from a stash on Zaton. Bring them to me for 2000 rubles and some equipment. I will mark the stash on your PDA.
Deal. I will bring them back.
Beard, I found your documents.
Thanks. Here are your 2000 rubles, a pistol, ammunition and medical supplies.
Pilot, who might want these documents?
Try Owl. He pays well for rare documents. You will have to explain yourself to Beard, though.
Understood. I will think about it.
Owl, I heard you are interested in documents.
I am. Five thousand for those. Are you selling?
Deal. They are yours.
No. I promised to return them to Beard.
Hold on, stalker. I know what those papers are. Hand them over for two thousand, and walk away.
All right. The documents for the money.
Two thousand is not enough. Add something.
You are getting nothing. Move aside!
Fine. Two thousand and a Sunrise suit. Final offer.
Deal. Money and armor for the documents.
No. I am keeping the documents.
Still not enough. Offer more.
Do you think I am a fool? We will take them by force!
Unknown stalker's PDA
Damn... didn't expect there'd be so many of them... Main thing... (coughs blood) Khh, khh... Hope Dark can find it... The farm... At the farm...
Note: 1 of 3
1 case out of 3. To Dark: the second case is on the bridge above. The client is waiting, so I advise you to hurry.
Locked suitcase
A heavy locked suitcase. Looks like it needs a specialist to open it.
Locked suitcase (2 of 3)
The second case mentioned in the Unknown's note.
Filya
A dead stalker. Looks like he didn't make it.
Find all of the Unknown's stashes
The Unknown's dying message mentioned several stashes. Find them all.
Find the Unknown's suitcase
The PDA mentions a farm. The suitcase should be somewhere on the Burnt Farmstead.
Find a way to open the suitcase
Ask the mechanic at the Skadovsk to open the suitcase. Or sell it to a trader.
Find the second suitcase
The note mentions a bridge above. Look for the second suitcase on the bridge.
Open the second suitcase
Take the second suitcase to the mechanic.
Hey, I found this suitcase. Can you open it?
Let me have a look...
Hmm, I think I can open it for 2000.
Alright, deal. [-2000 RUB]
I'll think about it.
I don't have that kind of money right now.
(hands over the suitcase)
